scope: technical-replicate uncertainty for published Homer1 BLI Kd ratios only; not biological-replicate inference

source_measurements.summary: arithmetic mean Kd and sample SD from n=3 technical replicates

assumptions: three technical replicate Kd estimates are independent within each peptide
variant and WT technical estimates are independent for the primary interval
first-order delta approximation on log ratio is adequate

dependence_sensitivity.interpretation: conservative delta-method bound for maximally adverse covariance between paired technical means, if the three runs are paired
does_not_cover: unknown effective sample size or dependence across repeated runs
curve-fit/model error not represented by reported replicate SD
systematic BLI calibration, preparation, or batch uncertainty

label_rule.gain: point ratio <=0.5 and both approximate upper interval bounds <1
label_rule.loss: point ratio >=2 and both approximate lower interval bounds >1
label_rule.status_semantics: technical-precision-supported source labels for an engineering feasibility pilot only; do not generalize biologically

score_boundary: No structural prediction or scorer output was inspected when this method was frozen.
